design_condition: Placed along the perimeter parallel to the highway, the volume forms a protected courtyard and maintains a connection to the excavation sites while allowing later extensions at both ends.

positive.statement: The structural and foundation concept is very carefully worked out and takes the essential points of building over the ruins into account.

position.rationale: Elongated building footprint and ground lines constrain the foundation region beneath the volume.

positive.statement: The calm appearance of the volume and its positioning lead to a good integration into the landscape.

position.rationale: Calm elongated mass is clearly visible across the top and four elevation views.

positive.statement: The project convincingly accommodates all functions in one large, homogeneous volume.

position.rationale: Continuous elongated enclosure is visible across the complete point-cloud envelope.

positive.statement: The abstract historical reference to the atrium typology makes sense.

position.rationale: Distinct central rectangular opening is clearly identifiable in the top view.

positive.statement: The noise-protected interior world goes beyond pure practicality and is convincing in its basic concept.

position.rationale: Interior acoustic realm is not distinguished, so it is approximated within the enclosed central building zone.

negative.statement: Delivery is functionally somewhat cramped, and the detached main entrance is not convincing in its addressing.

position.rationale: A plausible end-zone surface anchor represents the detached entrance and delivery interface.

negative.statement: The distance between delivery and the depot creates long internal operating routes and operational overlays that reveal the limits of the concept.

position.rationale: Internal operating routes are absent, approximated along the elongated building’s circulation direction.

negative.statement: The architectural design seems somewhat forced and inappropriate to the building's primary function as a place for research and storage.

position.rationale: The complete elongated mass provides the spatial anchor for the overall architectural expression.
